1. (Currently amended) A modular humeral implant comprising a first humeral surface component removably attached to a second stem component via a morse taper or screw connection mechanism.

2. (Currently amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first humeral surface component is a humeral articular surface and said second stem component is a removably attached intramedullary stem.

3. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral articular surface has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature.

4. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said coronal radius of curvature has a range of 10 to 50 mm.

5. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said axial radius of curvature has a range of from 10 to 50 mm.

6. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface has a depth with a range of from 5 to 40 mm.

7. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface has a thickness with a range of from 0.1 to 10 mm.

8. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein a ratio of a depth of said humeral surface to said coronal radius of curvature is from about 0.7 to about 0.9.

9. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral articular surface is spherically or elliptically shaped with a smooth articulating surface.

10. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface is made of a material selected from the group consisting of cobalt chrome alloy, ceramic, metal, and magnet materials.

11. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral articular surface further comprises fins or spikes on a concave undersurface of said humeral articular surface, said fins or spikes configured to promote bony ingrowth.

12. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 further comprising a concave undersurface configured for bony ingrowth material.

13. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral articular surface has a smooth articulating surface.

14. (Original) The implant of claim 3 wherein said attachable stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

15. (Original) The implant of claim 14 wherein said attachable stem is made of a material selected from the group consisting of titanium, stainless steel, tantalum, porous metal and trabecular metal.

16. (Original) The implant of claim 15 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a smooth, textured or threaded surface.

17. (Original) The implant of claim 16 wherein said removably attached stem is round, square, or triangular.

18. (Original) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises fins.

19. (Original) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a bony ingrowth surface.

20. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem has a selectable length from a plurality of stem lengths, wherein said stem extends from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus.

21. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem.

22. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper and a screw.

23. (Cancelled)

24. (Cancelled)

25. (Cancelled)

26. (Cancelled)

27. (Currently amended) A glenohumeral joint implant system comprising a transhumeral portal along a central axis of a neck of a proximal humerus and a modular humeral implant adapted to be implanted in the glenohumeral joint.

28. (Currently amended) The glenohumeral joint implant system of claim 27 wherein said implant is a humeral implant comprising a humeral surface component and a removably attached stem component.

29. (Currently amended) A humerus bone implant comprising a modular implant with a humeral surface component and a stem component, wherein said stem component is adapted to be anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of a humerus bone.

30. (Original) The humerus bone implant of claim 29 wherein said stem component has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

31. (Original) The humerus bone implant of claim 30 wherein said stem component is linear.

32. (Cancelled)
